tuition.note: Faculty of Social Studies, per academic year, studies starting February 2027 (3,000 EUR for September 2026); fees vary by faculty and programme

requirement.text: Secondary school certificate and transcript, ID/passport copy and proof of English (e.g. B2 certificate for Social Studies); faculty-specific extras such as a statement of purpose, essay, entrance exam or online interview. Deadlines differ by faculty (e.g. Arts 30 April, Social Studies 15 May for September intake).
